items.prompt: Why check equal column lengths before using zip to derive notional?

options.text: zip automatically rejects every length mismatch
options.why: Ordinary zip truncates to the shortest input unless a stricter mode is requested.

options.text: Every trade dataset must contain exactly two rows
options.why: The lesson contract allows different batch sizes, including empty input.

options.text: zip can silently omit an unmatched tail
options.why: Validation prevents that partial computation from looking complete.

options.text: Length checks establish currency identity and source timing
options.why: Those are additional semantic checks, not consequences of equal lengths.

items.explanation: The shortest-input behavior is useful in some programs but unsafe for a transform that promises one result per aligned row.
